purpose: Test whether opportunity-priced, repayment-enforced access to deterministic future refill closes the temporal-T2 static-to-online allocation gap.

frozen_policy.shadow_reference: outer-model scores on only its 84 non-evaluation training groups

credit_accounting.borrow_admission_rule: after the unchanged positive-reward and opportunity-price tests pass, admit exactly when canonical reservation is no greater than repayable credit
credit_accounting.debt_limit: causally remaining deterministic refill only; balance must be at least the negative of remaining refill after every decision
credit_accounting.required_final_balance: greater than or equal to zero after exact refill through measurement stop

mechanism_isolation.baseline: reproduce the frozen strict-current-credit online-v1 policy exactly
mechanism_isolation.changed_dimension: replace current spendable-credit admission with repayable-credit admission after the unchanged shadow-price test
mechanism_isolation.relation_to_failed_v4: V4 exposed future refill before valuing displaced actions. This mechanism first requires the current reward density to clear a fold-honest future-opportunity price.

required_diagnostics: decision counts and observed primary misses by gate, nonpositive reward, opportunity price, current credit, horizon credit, strict action, and borrowed action
action and captured-primary-miss counts by five-second time bin
per-run maximum debt and final balance after measurement-stop refill
pooled-frame doubly robust deadline-miss and completed-late18 estimates with shared whole-run bootstrap

engineering_screen.decision: advance to compiled closed-loop integration only if every screen passes; otherwise retain V2 and diagnose the failed boundary without consuming confirmation seeds

interpretation_limits: This screen reuses the 96 opened randomized groups and is not independent confirmation.
The action-clean lag-8 population excludes startup and action-dirty rows, so its absolute risks are not directly comparable with all-generated-frame closed-loop campaigns.
Doubly robust frame replay does not reproduce action-induced contention, queues, sender airtime, background throughput, or completed-frame P99.
Borrowing deterministic accounting credit can create transient airtime bursts; only a closed-loop campaign can qualify the less-than-1.20 sender-airtime and background-throughput gates.
Reserved seeds 1301 through 1348 must not be read by this screen.
